profileSummaries.defaultGame: The primary four-Era game: one optional 1-for-1 resource trade before resolution, local Power, immediate Headlines, and a static nineteen-district jurisdiction.
profileSummaries.advancedPlay: The bundled Advanced profile adds connected Networks, one Production Power request, procedural and persistent Headlines, Volatility, and Era III Jurisdictional Realignment.

changes.name: Immediate resource trade
changes.defaultText: Before resolution, offer exactly 1 Runway for 1 Compute or the reverse.
changes.decision: No gifts, bundles, same-resource trades, counteroffers, claims, post-action window, or trade-assisted selection.

changes.name: Production Power request
changes.advancedText: Each player may make one request through named adjacent Network endpoints.
changes.decision: Keep the market only where connected infrastructure makes it legible.

changes.name: Era III Jurisdictional Realignment
changes.advancedText: Players resolve the secret Era III ballot and rotate the selected ring or rings.
changes.decision: Retain in the bundled Advanced profile.

changes.name: Power topology
changes.defaultText: Power is local to the starting grid and nearby Generators.
changes.advancedText: Links create binary connected Networks and pooled Power; there is no Network bonus.
changes.decision: Use visible local Power in Default and graph connectivity in Advanced.

changes.name: Automatic Audit penalty
changes.decision: Every hit loses 1 Runway, falling back to 1 Trust, in every Era and for overflow.

changes.name: Persistent Headline regimes
changes.defaultText: Headlines expire after their cycle unless their Default text states otherwise.
changes.advancedText: Eligible Headline regimes may persist as printed.

changes.name: Headline public procedures
changes.defaultText: Only Default-eligible Headlines enter the deck.
changes.advancedText: Auctions, votes, secret choices, and negotiated procedures enter the deck.

changes.name: Headline Volatility
changes.defaultText: Volatility Headlines do not enter the deck.
changes.advancedText: Volatility Headlines enter and resolve their printed roll.

changes.name: Single Generator
changes.decision: Use one Generator per player; its Energy location fixes source, cost, and consequence.

changes.name: Equal-presence control
changes.decision: Every CEO, Team, and Facility contributes one presence; most controls and ties control nothing.

changes.name: Shared Program display
changes.decision: Use six shared public cards and two markers per player instead of thirty-six private copies and a track.

changes.name: Research Protection
changes.decision: Refresh one per player each Era, two for Orisonix; Research visits add one for that run. It is not currency.

changes.name: Deterministic Dossier
changes.decision: Require two supported evidence modules, then compare claim strength without a Prediction Bag or comeback points.

changes.name: Nineteen-hex jurisdiction
changes.decision: Use a complete radius-two board: one center, six inner districts, and twelve outer districts.

changes.name: Simplified profile boundary
changes.decision: Default contains the teachable core. Advanced adds Networks, one Power request, expanded Headlines, Volatility, and Realignment.
